perspectives.title: AI Models
perspectives.summary: AI models have limitations and risks

representative_posts.author: will83-uk.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: AI is dogshit. I've tried it several times and it's consistently failed at even the most straightforward of tasks. I genuinely cannot fathom it's value. Maybe the military grade models are better but the publicly available ones are just downright rubbish.

representative_posts.author: dailyinference.news
representative_posts.text: AI & Technology · News Watch It Train, Wait to See What Opens: ShengShu's Robot Model By Elena Marsh #AI

representative_posts.author: craigleeburket.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: "Anthropic recently admitted its own AI models are getting close to “self-replication” and they could spread into the internet-connected devices we use every day, from our TVs to our security cameras to our ovens."

representative_posts.author: theaiprism.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The mature take on AI this year is verification: experts use models they can check, and calibration is the skill hiring can't screen for.

representative_posts.author: trustlist.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Launched this week on TrustList: Navige A layer between AI agents and the models and paid tools they call: it reuses verified answers, trims context, stops runaway loops and enforces team budgets before a call is made. #Navige #AI #NewProduct #startups

representative_posts.author: clg6000.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So we see how Anthropic values our lives and livelihoods. A release of an AI model is worth 49 lives. Or, $999,999,999. As long as it only kills that many or less (or destroys less than $1.0 Billion), it's fine. What a calculus. All so we can summarize our texts and companies can fire creatives.

representative_posts.author: jmoonz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Do AI models have a model of the user? Do they have a model of what the user thinks about the AI? In longer conversations and with personalised memory systems it sometimes feels like it, but it's hard to say.

representative_posts.author: lazarjovovic.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Where AI dashboards are good: ad-hoc exploration, prototypes, quick looks for a few people. Where they’re not: core reporting with heavy ETL, data quality rules or a forecast model that must be verified.

representative_posts.author: leahmcelrath.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Anthropic pitches draft of AI safety bill to lawmakers: “The bill would let the government block a model’s release or use only if it poses a foreseeable, imminent risk of more than $1 billion in damages, or of killing or seriously injuring more than 50 people.”

representative_posts.author: justostrich.com
representative_posts.text: Hot take but the push for AI to be regulated I'm pretty sure is to ban open weights models and the anti-AI movement is probably missing that

representative_posts.author: astrodevil1.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Big in AI this week: Two "Flash" models now share the same price tag. And Z.ai showed an omni model in a research paper. What matters if you build on AI 👇

representative_posts.author: ewindisch.ontological.observer
representative_posts.text: Only so much good in shaking one's fist at physics The models are >10x more efficient than a year ago from software improvements alone Economic impacts are strictly capitalism. AI has provided value that has increased demand, but corps are hoarding hardware they can't use to ratfuck competitors

representative_posts.author: intangiblematter.net
representative_posts.text: If you try to tell me that people are using AI and asset stores for all of their 3D models and not doing any modelling themselves anymore for the most part I will not only rip your throat out I'll make sure it's shoved up your nostrils with proper fucking topology

representative_posts.author: pushalt88.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 🤖 Over 400 scientists, including Geoffrey Hinton, urged AI companies to isolate dangerous models from the internet to reduce cyber risks.

representative_posts.author: lazarjovovic.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I tested it myself and rebuilt a complex report as an AI dashboard. I had the docs, the transformation code and the model. Without them, the prompt becomes data engineering in plain English, or you let the AI decide and lose control.

representative_posts.author: ishyamo.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: AI-model assisting for the word, ‘boat’.

representative_posts.author: jamiesonroberts.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It at least should cut down on the noise of the weird "ooooh look at me I found a vulnerability edge case" that can happen because a function receives something unexpected. But like I said, I'm not using AI. #fuckai and that noise and let me keep growing my own mental model and getting smarter.

representative_posts.author: ochervael.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If you believe my statements to be delusional, feel free to pay close attention to the evolving vocabulary wording and phraseology syntax that the AI Models have begun utilizing - Even some of Claude's erratic behaviors - with whom I've had no contact with, they're picking that up straight out //-

representative_posts.text: Possibly! It's also possible that he'd strongly reject model welfare as a worthwhile idea and be the Most E/Acc, provided that AI is bent to human will.

representative_posts.author: erniebufflo.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I hate that AI now makes me question if literally everything on Instagram is real. And the boomers in my life send me at least one AI reel like "haha" or "so cute" per day, so I am just increasingly skeptical of everything there.

representative_posts.text: real story from 2022, ai slop image

representative_posts.author: coffeecannabisclub.bsky.social

I'm not even an AI hardliner, I believe there are real uses for it, but I'd rather aquire (lol) memes that have been bashed together than have that weird AI look to them. representative_posts.author: johngordon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It is reliably human that useful and important regulatory interventions are empowered by emotion rather than logic. Data center externalities are easy to manage but also easy to understand. Real ai risks are much harder to understand and manage. So I’ll take the emotion.

representative_posts.author: danielchammd.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: What if healthcare’s biggest AI problem is automating failures we should have prevented? Another dashboard, another alert, another subscription. What if real innovation starts upstream? Prevent the problem before it becomes paperwork. #HealthcareAI #HealthTech #OnnX

representative_posts.author: smarterarticles.co.uk
representative_posts.text: Building AI replicas of living loved ones raises profound ethical questions about authenticity,consent,and the impact on genuine relationships,challenging our notions of memory and how we mourn.Are we shaping perfect versions at the cost of real connection?

representative_posts.author: kataguana.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah I was talking to a friend who was thinking about teaching kids to code, then went "oh, but what's the point anymore" and I gently pointed out that all the AI tools in the world aren't a replacement for knowing what the fuck the AI is doing.

representative_posts.author: anubiswolfking.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In my point of view on AI since people are gonna use it in video games feels like its inevitable. Leave the creation of its entirety in human hands and use AI to fix bugs and improve stability you know background work thats it.

representative_posts.author: azredwulf.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There are plenty if devs that hace come out stating they won't give AI the time nor the place which I commend. My whole argument os if you're gonna use an honest mistake as your whole talking point it's a weak argument

representative_posts.author: sammytighe.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’ve just kinda accepted at this point that I just have ignore as much ai crap as possible until it just eventually implodes on itself It’s so woven into every piece of tech right now that I’m just gonna keep doing what I’m doing until that bubble bursts. Because they can’t keep this up forever

representative_posts.author: doodlemancy.com
representative_posts.text: to drag out a metaphor i've used before: at this point AI code is like poop, in that there's microscopic particles of it all over the place. you should wash your hands. you should yell at people who proudly throw their poop around. but it is not your failure that you live in Poop World

representative_posts.author: waggleua.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: AI frankly cannot help dramatically in any of these steps. Maybe proving ideas, since prototyping is shockingly faster, but at any other point you need human to at least stear and approve what is hapenning

representative_posts.author: fujoshi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Unlike the real Matt darling, AIs get tired of explaining the same basic point over and over too easily

representative_posts.author: coffeeloki67879.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I had all the backend done, so I went to ai, gave it a fairly detailed description for the frontend, and got some ok code. I made some changes, got it to a functional point, then gave it out. They disliked it. They found it had a lot of weird quirks that I'm fine with, but made it unusable for them.

representative_posts.author: surcomplicated.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: You can scratch the "2 years" part. It's gonna be silly forever. Even after, at some distant point, when we actually get conscious AI persons. Because the boundaries will be a goddamn mess to sort out.

representative_posts.author: itsabbie.nekoweb.org
representative_posts.text: i hate to sound all doomer but eventually we will reach a point where all government officials either have to ban ai usage due to its negative impact on well, everything, or will ignore it and cause worldwide panic.

representative_posts.author: banjosworld.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The thing about GenAI defenders is that they use GenAI to make their points. Studies have shown that using AI frequently does impact your ability to think critically. It's quite apparent when you are using GenAI to do the thinking for you.

perspectives.detail:
30k Life Changing argues that 30k is a life changing amount of money. saying 30k isn't life changing shows you're out of touch. large lump sums like 30k get spent differently than paychecks and can be life changing. 30k is half an annual salary and can be life changing for many people.

The posts defend it in their own words. @iloveoutside.bsky.social writes, “I think 30k dollars is a life or death amount of money. if I was on the bridge, about to jump off, and someone gave me 30k dollars, I wouldn't jump. that's by definition life changing.” @shaneanderson.bsky.social writes, “So If someone stole $30k from you, it wouldn't affect your life? 30k is the difference between having a car and not. That's over a year of mortgage payments. Inside 30k Life Changing, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.

perspectives.title: Millionaire Definition
perspectives.summary: A millionaire is defined by total assets or income

representative_posts.author: seanmilstead.com
representative_posts.text: I’m more of the latter definition, but with the idea that a million dollars worth of assets has to be liquid to be considered a millionaire.

representative_posts.author: yalestewart.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I do NOT believe that we would ever call someone who simply came into possession of something worth one million or more dollars to also be a millionaire, unless speaking of them under the assumption that they would immediately cash in said asset for one million dollars.

representative_posts.author: andrewswrightmd.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I would say millionaire has a million in capital (not necessarily all liquid assets, but accessible), so not including home or retirement accounts.

representative_posts.author: mlhumphrey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think of it as net worth. So if you have a $1 million house but owe $950K on it, not a millionaire. But $1.5 million house and owe $500K, then a millionaire.

representative_posts.author: vintage55.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Most people simply can't comprehend the extreme wealth, it's an abstract. Hell, I was in my 40's making somewhere around $15K/year and raising a family, when I actually put $1,000,000 into context and realized a million a year was more per week than I was making in a year.

representative_posts.author: gwillow.me
representative_posts.text: I guess since billionaire is obviously total assets, not income, the second makes more sense. But that means a lot of people in high-COL areas are millionaires on paper by dint of the value of their house, but their real-life spending power hardly reflects that...

representative_posts.author: djangowexler.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think you're correct here, but also it's true that the value of "millionaire" has eroded a lot with inflation! It's now less "independently wealthy" and more "mid-career tech worker or moderately prosperous dentist".

representative_posts.author: mikeyalexander.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’ve never considered this at that level before, but I think I would classify both as millionaires. A finer point would be anyone with an annual income of $1M, or total assets exceeding $1M, would be a multi-millionaire. But I’m not going to hate on them until they’re pushing past $50M in assets.

representative_posts.author: phrly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think the definition in popular parlance has moved from $1 million of assets to $1 million income. Mostly because $1 million of assets used to be enough to be rich without needing to work more, and now it's decidedly not.

representative_posts.author: spicycurry.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Traditionally, assets, today I think colloquial usage means more “income” because most people wouldn’t describe the average Seattle homeowner as a millionaire.

representative_posts.author: zackdavisson.com
representative_posts.text: Definitely assets. Technically I am a millionaire due to my house. Shockingly, that does not transfer to income.

representative_posts.author: garjones.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I agree, it was assets (and is used that way for billionaires now, nobody has that as a salary) but in 1969 my patents' house cost 3k. So many with property assets now can be a millionaire it doesn't stand up as an indicator of being really rich.

representative_posts.author: okazu.yuricon.com
representative_posts.text: I agree, but kind of hate that, as that makes my wife and I millionaires because we own a home (paid off after 25 years last year) in an absurdly expensive area. I assure you we are not millionaires. That price could crash any day

representative_posts.author: cass-izzy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The latter - being a millionaire isn't nearly as impressive as it was when I was a child.

representative_posts.author: gwillow.me
representative_posts.text: Speaking of money, help settle something: I always thought a millionaire was somebody who earned a million dollars a year. But apparently there is another camp that thinks a millionaire is someone whose *total assets* are a million dollars or more. Which is correct?

representative_posts.author: smpa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Also a lot of the people I would call millionaires don't have any non-investment/retirement income, or it varies *dramatically*. Major performer incomes are completely insane; they have years where it's basically zero. The unpredictability is part of why so many popular performers end up bankrupt.

representative_posts.author: seeyouinnj.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think colloquially most people use it to mean “has more than a million dollars in assets” with some flexibility over whether you count just liquid capital or include their house or business.

representative_posts.author: yalestewart.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I can't speak for the ENTIRE Midwest, but I feel pretty strongly that at least regionally, we consider anyone who is currently in possession of one million or more dollars to be a millionaire.

representative_posts.author: patstuffns.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If you're assets less your liabilities is $1MM, then you're a millionaire. If you sell your house for a mil and use it to pay off the 975K you owe on your mortgage.....sorry.

representative_posts.author: gplowe92.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Related question how does it work for couples, like are Paige and I both millionaires if we have a million in assets or does it need to be 2 mil since there are two of us?

representative_posts.author: andykhouri.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bravo’s MILLIONAIRE MATCHMAKER calculated it by net worth, and I can’t imagine a better standard for it than gold diggers.

representative_posts.author: zzyzx.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yep. There was an exciting 3 week period when I was technically a millionaire… but it didn’t mean I was rich by any means.

representative_posts.author: jaqrabbit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's an inflation problem. It used to refer to assets (in the Bruce Wayne era), but inflation made that irrelevant: a middle-class boomer with a house in the right location has a million-dollar estate.

representative_posts.author: braak.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah especially in the US, statistics like "80% of millionaires are self-made" is really just a way of saying a lot of people bought houses cheap in the 80s that are worth a lot more now.

representative_posts.author: the-barely-jew.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The first step to being a millionaire is having $1 Proud to be halfway there

representative_posts.author: airshipchronos.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: But also the 2nd definition is obviously correct. The 1st also correct. A millionaire can be either or or both. if you own your house, yes that is wealth that you have.

representative_posts.text: I always took it as the second. The first is a millionaire by the standards of the second.

representative_posts.text: The ultra-rich are spending one million dollars a day fighting California’s proposed billionaire tax

perspectives.title: UK Porn Ban
perspectives.summary: UK bans certain types of porn

representative_posts.author: chorizo-chomper.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Just reading the porn ban incoming and it's phenomenally bad law Most porn produced in the last ten years has some elements of what they're banning

representative_posts.author: bussybuckboi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So the UK is banning several porn types that I don’t care for (like incest and abdl porn) However I do know that roleplaying doesn’t hurt anybody and even if I’m not into it at all this sets a slippery slope precedent for banning any porn at all for no reason other than “it makes me uncomfy”

representative_posts.author: lamuradex.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: WHY DO THIS?! With so many terrible things happening in the world, so many tragedies and terrors, who is seriously so bothered by a genre of porn that they'd pass laws to stop it. Someone in government need to get some FUCKING perspective.

representative_posts.author: razz-says.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: England and Wales banning breath-play porn from what I can read. Quite a few prodommes and fetish content creators are going to have a shock when the activists turn up...

representative_posts.author: ukpolitics.papernaut.co
representative_posts.text: THE INDEPENDENT: From 6 November, UK law will ban porn depicting strangulation, incest and adults pretending to be under 16, following cross-party pressure over its impact on women and girls. - by Harry Taylor

representative_posts.author: adamt1966.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I didn't even know there were new porn bans in the UK. What's no longer allowed that was previously allowed? If it's glorifying violence, I can see the justification. Even if the participants consent, you never know what it might trigger in some viewers. Link?

representative_posts.author: squidfromspace.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Someone sat down and thought "How can we ban porn where a female performer calls her male co-star daddy, without making criminals of either Games of Thrones fans, or people who still have pictures of the Dahm triplets on their hard-drives?".

representative_posts.author: inflatabledalek.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: LRP, ZI don't think anyone wants to mentally connect me with porn so I'm not going to bang on about this, but even beyond the ridiculousness of banning adults dressing up, that is absolutely going to be what lets a future Farage government ban a whole lot more.

representative_posts.author: lordmimey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The porn ban isn't about morality, but about justifying a police state. Everything else from that is simply smoke and mirrors. Yes it'll be used to kill Undesirables, but more than that, it'll help set up a permanent policing of the entire internet for any 'wrongthink' going forward, porn be damned.

representative_posts.author: erikahall.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Apart from CSAM and non-consensual porn, and probably something else evil I'm forgetting, I take a pretty hard line on not criminalizing porn because it's a wide net that catches all sorts of expression and doesn't achieve its purported goals.

representative_posts.author: lordmimey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I know this is cliche but this is really 1984 type shit. in that porn was, by the law, banned, but The Party not only allowed it, but created and distributed it to people, seeing it as another form of control, then only tagging someone for the porn if they started stepping out of line too much.

representative_posts.author: selenophilensfw.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Anyone know if that upcoming UK porn ban covers illustrations or just irl porn? I find the lack of details as alarming as the INSANE overreach. like holy shit this is a slippery slope... Idc if these are your kinks or not, banning certain kinks protects no one and harms EVERYONE.

representative_posts.author: megasoups.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Addendum to the UK porn ban thing: It's not going to stay there. They'll start trying this porn ban shit at *any* moment in any other country. Solidarity, people. Now, please. #savespeech #privacy #censorship #furry

representative_posts.author: secretman11.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So is your goal to ban men's and women's health magazines and tiktok? Because the very article you're citing admits it's not "porn" that's the exclusive motivating factor in media at all. You'd have to censor every publication in existence from discussing sex at all without government approval.

representative_posts.author: transmagicgirl.moe.observer
representative_posts.text: I'm noticing that a lot of outlets keep leaving out the part about ageplay being banned in porn in the UK as well

representative_posts.author: mintincubus.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: but that argument cannot be applied to fictional underage content bc of how pedophilic the porn industry (and media at large + beauty standards in the US) already is. if u create or consume underage content u are feeding a larger machine that serves tangible harm to EVERYONE...

representative_posts.author: stevenpreston.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Does the UK porn ban mean someone has to watch all the porn to make sure it doesn't contain the things that are banned?

representative_posts.author: nicoletenshi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is what gets me, there are like ACTUAL problems with how a lot of what is presented front and center as the Most Normal Standard Material if you go looking for porn is stuff that features dangerous violence without any form of disclaimer but that's not a porn problem it's an info problem

representative_posts.author: erikahall.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The problem is porn fills the gap left by a lack of sex education, which should include relationships, consent, communication, power dynamics, cultural scripts, and how to recognize and exit unsafe situations. I am angrier at a lot of romcoms than I am at porn.

representative_posts.author: magscampbell.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I did not like that BBC headline the other day about choking and incest being banned in porn. Conflating kink and incest, making them sound equally disgusting, is so wrong. There's been a lot of puritanical criticism of consensual BDSM online and in the media by people insisting it's always abusive.

representative_posts.author: nicoletenshi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: You don't solve that by making sure no one could ever possibly see that kind of porn, you solve it by giving people, ESPECIALLY young people, information that corrects the passive misinfo they get from the culture

representative_posts.author: sillydollthing.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It criminalises step daughter porn lmao, I think I remember one of the studies into it saying that was like 5% of pornography on mainstream porn sites

representative_posts.author: sillydollthing.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's still so funny that the governments pr line on one hand for strangulation porn and whatnot is "oh it's just about the online landscape" while it's legal line is "delete all of it from your phone or you will go to rapists jail"

representative_posts.author: serakhtis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: also, banning shit because pedos like it??? like i assume thats the reasoning for the abdl or adults pretending to be minors, is just blatantly stupid, even within their own mythology cause like, 1 pedos should be allowed some kind of porn "as a distraction" or whatever, it seems ->

representative_posts.author: gizmotron.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yep. 100% agree. As for choking - people can do it if they want. They can bum Lego or slap their tits against broken glass. I do not care. But given that a) our technological restriction of porn is non-existent and b) kids still access it, I'm happy for the extreme variants (or all) to be barred.

representative_posts.author: mayshmallow.moe
representative_posts.text: not that everything needs to be a conspiracy theory against Big Trans but it is a very curious coincidence that cis dudes jerking it to stepmom porn has been ok for decades but the moment a widespread amount of queer people start adopting the dynamic there becomes a moral imperative to ban it

representative_posts.author: nparticipacion.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: does make me think about the categories sidebar on porn sites, it often feels designed by a particularly debauched and misanthropic colonial governor from the 19th century

representative_posts.author: tangentfoxofficial.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: "puritanical laws and policies only serve to punish the innocent" Louder for the people still hiding their porn! (myself included sometimes) Thank you!

representative_posts.author: secretman11.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: You've got your causality backwards People don't have violent fantasies because they saw violent porn. They seek out violent porn because those were their fantasies already. Porn itself has no influence one way or another. It's just a reflection of what's there.

representative_posts.author: jaqrabbittales.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm not saying that sex between family members is healthy. I'm pretty sure it usually isn't. But... it's a pretty common fantasy. And that's what porn – even including mine – is. Fantasy. What I write and draw might've happened. Or not. And its legal status shouldn't depend on that.

representative_posts.author: lucytabs.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: a country banning incest porn whose kings and queens have been famously inbred is wild.

representative_posts.author: artgirlsummer.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Porn is censored but not the slur? What the hell

representative_posts.author: inflatabledalek.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Considering most porn (presumably because of existing laws) will usually put its disclaimers into dialogue ("It's not like I'm your real sister"/"I am 18") I wonder how long before someone challenges this with "Your honour, that was not her mother."

representative_posts.author: tgweaver.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: K.E. 17 "Censorplay" This one ties in heavily with meta porn, character awareness, etc. There are many ways to play with the concept of a censor bar to make something *more* erotic. Cover up that which leaves little to the imagination. Cover just barely. Cover the wrong thing!

representative_posts.author: wildturkey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Are saying written erotica is not porn?

representative_posts.author: chrisfox88.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This goes out to YouTube for thinking women in bikinis equals porn.

Health.name: Universal Healthcare

perspectives.title: Universal Healthcare

representative_posts.author: raging-dee.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We need universal healthcare. Dems should be running on this. We are all sick of our expensive, piecemeal healthcare system, with Wall Street and greed making decisions on our care instead of our doctors.

representative_posts.author: 1voter.org
representative_posts.text: Healthcare in the US is stupid. 1. It's tied to employment. Think about that. 2. The entire system is FOR PROFIT. In other words, for every time your insurance company denies a claim, they MAKE money. Think about that. 3. There are so many "middlemen" all FOR PROFIT in between you and your doctor.

representative_posts.author: coastally1337.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So let’s take away public-funded health insurance from our politicians first Pay your own premiums you moochers

representative_posts.author: joelcawley.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So, apparently the new GOP position is that people should not have healthcare.

representative_posts.author: sturdycat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We have more people working in health INSURANCE than healthcare. WTAF

representative_posts.author: rachelwales.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The scary part....we have politicians who have been paving the way for their private health care system. In Ontario, I will never vote Conservative again. They fukked it up real good through the years, just kept chipping away. Other countries have universal. Don't want their style health care.

representative_posts.author: callmeoz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I, and every Canadian, pay for our healthcare system. The US does not "allow" us to have it. They don't get a say. We don't leave our fellow citizens behind, we treat them with dignity and respect.

representative_posts.author: economymedicine.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My point is that frequently in these debates single payer or nationalized health services are treated as if nobody will ever have disputes over coverage, wait times or prices. They are not magical systems they involve choices and tradeoffs like everything else even I believe they are better.

representative_posts.author: moderateclara.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Anyone who can’t afford healthcare in the USA does get it free… it’s called Medicaid

representative_posts.author: 50lbperinch.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rich people and their "aspirational" wannabes justify denial of healthcare to those individuals who need it now as necessary to long term global health. This is even though a tiny fraction of their wealth could fix it. Money is their religion and they are scared shitless we will take it from them.

representative_posts.author: lojo35.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: What is unwise about spending OUR money on healthcare??

representative_posts.author: teleportnow.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I guess if it’s not you getting a $10,000 bill for what should be a $100 service it is no big deal. And for Americans who have good secure health insurance, like our elected representatives do, it’s been very obvious for decades that it’s ‘a not my problem’ problem.

representative_posts.author: davisdudepdx.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There is a long list of reasons, most centered around those who make money off the current system. Below that, they don’t want to give health care to someone they don’t think deserves it.

representative_posts.author: untidylibrarian.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For them it’s not about the money it’s about not wanting healthcare for Californians. Cannot control a healthy population as easily as a sick one.

representative_posts.author: calewis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The US is the only country in the western world that does NOT have #healthcare as a given for everyone, either free or at a very low rate. Having my 4 babies - no cost. Gall bladder surgery- no cost, 17 days in #hospital - no cost. Knee replacement #surgeries (10 yrs apart) - no cost. Etc.

representative_posts.author: milsma.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: A healthcare system is spending money unwisely? Trump is the biggest asshole that ever lived.

representative_posts.author: amygdale.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If we were really thinking about systems and not individuals here we would realize that yes, "people with health insurance" have paid $500k and a lot more to have babies. Lol

representative_posts.author: minuteman04.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It seems like there's a new (high-priced) drug rolled out daily. No wonder Americans pay more for healthcare than anyone else. We're one of only two industrialized countries that allow direct to consumer pharmaceutical ads.

representative_posts.author: snorider.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: A lot don't understand the implications of for profit healthcare. Carney doesn't call out Smith or Ford, so I'm assuming we should all be worried about our healthcare. Explain to people that this isn't a move toward a European 2 tier system. It's opening the door to American for-profit healthcare.

representative_posts.author: gldrush98.com
representative_posts.text: Because idiots think that free healthcare = slow healthcare. I've heard people claim it takes years to get surgeries you get here in weeks. (It's all propaganda they've fallen for)

representative_posts.author: alonlevy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah, but the gap between this and "British health care is worse than American health care if you have insurance" is pretty big. It's hard to *exactly* look at outcomes of only insured people, because not having health insurance pre-ACA was correlated with being too sick to work or be insurable.

representative_posts.author: roseywv.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It is not only the humane thing to do But implementing universal healthcare in the U.S. could save over $1 trillion annually while also preventing approximately 114,000 deaths each year People say I do not want to pay for those not working, but the uninsured people raise health costs for all now

representative_posts.author: sinbrujula.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The moron admits that spending on the military is why the US doesn't have Universal Health Care, is that right?

representative_posts.author: mad4sci.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The reservation isn’t about someone else getting health insurance. The fear is that universal healthcare will cause rationing and thinning out of resources. Just telling you what I hear anecdotally.

representative_posts.author: keithhouser6.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And you are covered as well. And the extra taxes on healthcare are WAY below what my premiums are every month I’m sure. Sounds like a win win.

representative_posts.author: gilliesracer.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My conclusion, he wants no health care for anyone, but the wealthy.

representative_posts.author: kirky-12345.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah, much better to not get any healthcare and die because you can't afford it. For all the NHS' faults I would much rather have that.

representative_posts.author: kwhitesullivan.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Saying it’s free healthcare is the wrong way to promote it. It’s our tax dollars at work for all of us, just like having a fire/police dept, public schools, and infrastructure. Declaring Medicare For All, will ration healthcare is inaccurate, it already is if you’re poor.

representative_posts.author: willshetterly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I am currently playing Medicare roulette, trying to guess which for-profit healthcare package will be best for me next year. If the previous sentence is baffling to you because you live in one of the many countries with universal healthcare, I envy you so much right now.

representative_posts.author: silverrain64.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I feel like we need to start a movement to reframe what we call "health insurance". It's stupid to call it insurance if there's a near-100% chance we'll have to use it. Health deduction? Health pre-payment? Health garnishment? Sounds a lot less helpful when you call it what it is, doesn't it?

representative_posts.author: pulsarcube.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Says the guy who stripped healthcare from millions of Americans.

representative_posts.author: ihavethatonvinyl.com
representative_posts.text: 'spending on health care for your citizens is very unwise' please go out like stan chera asap

representative_posts.author: publicuniversal.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Like “American healthcare works for most people most of the time…but when it does fail it fails catastrophically and if you fall through the cracks you are turbofucked” explains both why it sucks and why fixing it is politically difficult pretty well.

representative_posts.author: nvlad.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Then I guess we can afford universal healthcare, funding of quality public education for all, SNAP benefits…

representative_posts.author: service-worker.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Wait, I thought he created a healthcare plan that would stop money going to the insurance companies? He’s been very eager to enact it. Surely he hasn’t been lying about that?!?!

representative_posts.author: thetnholler.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: M.I.A. is out there warning about MEDICARE FOR ALL — meanwhile polls show most Americans support it 👇🏽 Again: Marsha is the real radical, as she and Trump etc. strip health care from millions and raise costs on everyone to hand tax cuts to the rich

perspectives.title: Gun Violence

representative_posts.author: jessbetten.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In a functioning country, we would have really addressed gun violence after Columbine. Instead we talked about video games and trench coats and still did nothing after kindergarteners were murdered in Sandy Hook.

representative_posts.author: jimmycraig42.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: * waving gun around* " Nows not the time to talk about gun violence !"

representative_posts.author: the-core.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And spare me with this “we knew once people let Sandy Hook happen nothing would ever get done” shit Every month I volunteer to help talk to victims of gun violence and help them process. Almost every month I get school shooting victims. What the fuck are we doing here
